evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: We introduce the Active Causal Discovery Benchmark (ACDB), an SCM-grounded environment for evaluating whether LLM agents recover causal graph structure from observations and budget-constrained hard interventions.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: ACDB pairs a linear-Gaussian world generator with a fixed observe-intervene-submit API and a three-layer scoring contract that separates skeleton recovery, DAG recovery, and intervention efficiency.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: A structure-blind random DAG baseline reaches 23.6% directed F1 on this dense v0 ladder; a density probe lowers this floor to 16.9%, motivating the v1 calibration pass.
